The pole p2 = gm6/CL sits near the UGB, so Rz places an LHP zero on p2 for PM. Long-L pair (L=2) and tail give the gain, flicker area and CMRR. M3, M4 and M6 share L and gm/Id, so there is no systematic offset. Low vdsat sets the swing."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 24.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),        # input pair L (gain + flicker area)
    "gmidp": (13.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # PMOS mirror + PMOS CS gm/Id (shared -> no sys. offset)
    "Lp":    (0.6, 0.35, 1.5),       # PMOS L (shared M3/M4/M6)
    "gmidn": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),      # NMOS current-source gm/Id (low vdsat for swing)
    "Ln":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "Itail": (8e-6, 5e-6, 11e-6),
    "I6":    (18e-6, 12e-6, 21e-6),
    "Cc":    (0.40e-12, 0.2e-12, 1.0e-12),
    "kz":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # Rz scale vs pole-cancelling value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]

    # Bias diode (sinks Iref) and mirrored NMOS sources
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=None or 0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)

    # PMOS mirror load and CS output device (same gm/Id, L -> same Vsg)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=0.95)
    m4 = m3
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)
    vo1 = vdd - m3.vgs

    # Input pair, source at tail node
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.28)
    vtail = 0.9 - m1.vgs

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1, gm6 = m1.gm, m6.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    A2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd + m4.cgd   # first-stage output node
    Cout = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    wu = gm1 / Cc
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (C1 * Cout + Cc * (C1 + Cout))
    Rz = p["kz"] * (1.0 / gm6 + 1.0 / (Cc * p2))
    z = 1.0 / (Cc * max(Rz - 1.0 / gm6, 1.0))
    p3 = 1.0 / (Rz * C1)
    pm_mir = gm1 * 0 + m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(wu / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / pm_mir)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(wu / (2 * pm_mir)))
    ugbw = wu / (2 * PI)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (Cout + Cc))
    settle = 4.6 / (wu * 0.8) + 0.9 / slew
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I6)
    cmrr_db = db(A1 * 2 * m3.gm / mt.gds)
    psrr_db = db(A1 * A2 / max(1.0, A2 * 0.05 + 1.0))  # rough; Miller PSRR ~ stage-1 gain-limited
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.05
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(2 * kT4 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise_1k = noise_th * 3.0   # flicker margin factor at 1 kHz

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x1", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db, "swing": swing,
               "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "noise_1k": noise_1k}
```
